title: Network Manager
full_description:
Luxembourg, Luxembourg
Your role & work environment
Based in Luxembourg City, the Network manager oversees the selection, the periodic review and ongoing monitoring of the securities counterparties network of ING Luxembourg and ING Belgium
Your key responsibilities
Selection of counterparties with the expertise of the Network Management team of ING NL
Account openings with the external and internal set-up
Periodic review of the service levels of the parties (market evolutions, procedural changes, …)
Annual due diligence requests considering regulations such as MIFID, UCITS and AIFMD
Fee negotiations if applicable
Meetings with counterparties
Maintenance of all documentation related to the relationship as well as specific operational procedures
Best execution controls as required by MIFID regulation
Collection of solvability ratios that are issued by the ING Group
Maintenance of the centralized folder with all counterparty data and SSI
Ad Hoc intervention in case of recurring SLA breach (Transfer Agent, Sub-custodians, cash correspondents)
Set-up of quarterly Network Management committees
ISAE 3402 update / compliance for Network Management
For nostro relationships, maintenance of folder g/shared related to correspondents (agreement, operational aspects, …)
In coordination with FMS, selection of new provider as well as the migration
Cash account opening/closing in compliance with the SOP (Standard of practice) policy
One nostro implementation
A colleague with atalent for taking it on and making ithappen,enthusiasm forhelping others to be successfuland a knack for alwaysbeing a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.
As a Network Manager you will also need:
Minimum Bac+5 in finance, economy or equivalent
Or professional experience of at least five years in securities operations management
Fluent in English and French
knowledge of securities operations management
Ability to work in a dynamic environment
Driven and customer focused, loving to collaborate with different people
Good analytical skills
Proven planning & organizational skills to meet the deadlines
Clear communication skills: written and oral
Ability to work in an autonomous way and to take initiative
Making things happen thanks to your ‘can do’ attitude
A very stimulating & exciting job
An opportunity to acquire in-depth knowledge of the ING and exposure to many executive stakeholders
We redefine banking. What about you?
